outcome: Risk of different types of PPH
cohort: All singleton deliveries in Norway from 1967-2017 (3,003,025 births)
finding: Maternal, fetal and obstetric characteristics had differential effects on types of PPH, and recurrence risk differed considerably between PPH types.
mod_finding: This study found that previous cesarean section was strongly associated with postpartum hemorrhage due to dystocia.
